text: The plan shall identify module, execution-contract digest, profile, and every defined function's complete frame size, callee-owned native reservation excluding nested callees, local shadow extent, and checked sites. Locals shall record declaration ordinal, canonical type key, offset/size, initial state, tracking choice, and bitmap offset/size. Sites shall record opcode, fixed costs, and runtime-dependent resource domains.
